import { observer, inject } from "mobx-react"

import CodePosition from '../pages/CodePosition'
import LaserLine from '../pages/LaserLine'

@inject('qdsstore')
@observer
export default class DataBaseUI extends React.Component {
  constructor(props){
    super(props);
      this.state = {
        qds: this.props.qdsstore.qdsData,
        smiley0: this.props.qdsstore.smiley0,
        smiley1: this.props.qdsstore.smiley1,
        data: lstJobList,
    };

}

  handleCellClick(rowIndex, columnIndex, row, column) {
       console.log('rowIndex: ' + rowIndex + ' columnIndex: ' + columnIndex);
  }

  handleCellDoubleClick(rowIndex, columnIndex, row, column) {
     console.log('rowIndex: ' + rowIndex + ' columnIndex: ' + columnIndex);
  }

  handleSortOrderChange(key, order) {
     console.log('key:' + key + ' order: ' + order);
  }

  deselectOnClickaway(selectedRows){
    console.log('selectedRows: ' + selectedRows );
  }

  handleRowSelection(selectedRows) {
    console.log('selectedRows: ' + selectedRows );

    //deselcted row --> show last image
    var length = this.state.qds.length;

    if(this.state.selectedRows == selectedRows){}
      this.setState(
         {
           normal: this.state.qds[length-1].camera,
           overlay: this.state.qds[length-1].overlay,
           selectedImage: false,
           selectedRows: selectedRows,
         }
      );
    }
    else{
      //row selected --> show user selected image
      this.setState(
         {
           normal: this.state.qds[selectedRows].camera,
           overlay: this.state.qds[selectedRows].overlay,
           selectedImage: true,
           selectedRows: selectedRows,
         }
       );
    }


  }

  render() {


    const table_columns = [
      {
        key: 'jobID',
        label: 'jobID',
      },
      {
        key: 'timestamp',
        label: 'Date',
      },
    ];
    const styles = {
      marginTop: "40px"
    }

 return(

  <div>
    <DashboardHeader data = {this.state.qds} />
    <div style={styles}>
    <div class="row">
         <div class="col-lg-4" >
            <Card class="myCard">
              <CardBlock>
                <CardTitle>Select your ID </CardTitle>
                              <DataTables
                                fixedHeader = {true}
                                selectable={true}
                                showRowHover={true}
                                enableSelectAll={false}
                                columns={table_columns}
                                selectable={true}
                                height={"800"}
                                showCheckboxes={true}
                                data={this.state.data}
                                onCellClick={this.handleCellClick}
                                onCellDoubleClick={this.handleCellDoubleClick}
                                onFilterValueChange={this.handleFilterValueChange}
                                onSortOrderChange={this.handleSortOrderChange}
                                onRowSelection={this.handleRowSelection.bind(this)}
                                onDeselectOnClickAway={this.deselectOnClickaway}
                                count={30}/>
                    </CardBlock>
                  </Card>
              </div>

              <div class="col-lg-4">
                      <CodePosition data={this.state.qds}/>
                      <CardDeck>
                        <Image image={this.state.normal} title={"Before Image processing"}/>
                        <Image image={this.state.overlay} title={"After Image processing"}/>
                      </CardDeck>
              </div>

              <div class="col-lg-4" >
                    <LaserLine data={this.state.qds} maxValue={0.93} minValue={0.85} qualityMin={0.86} qualityMax={0.905} smiley={1}/>
                    <LaserLine data={this.state.qds} maxValue={0.93} minValue={0.85} qualityMin={0.86} qualityMax={0.905} smiley={0}/ >
                </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      </div>
  )
}
}
